local near,closest=nil,math.huge
for _,m in enemies do

local function jointsActive(model)
 local n=0
 for _,v in model:GetDescendants() do
  if (v:IsA("Motor6D") or v:IsA("AnimationConstraint")) and (v.Name=="LeftShoulder" or v.Name=="RightShoulder" or v.Name=="LeftHip" or v.Name=="RightHip" or v.Name=="Waist" or v.Name=="Neck") then
   local _,a=v.Transform:ToAxisAngle()
   if a>0.045 then n+=1 end
  end
 end
 return n
end
local n1a,n2a=jointsActive(near),jointsActive(allies[1])
task.wait(0.30)
local n1b,n2b=jointsActive(near),jointsActive(allies[1])

for _,role in expectedRoles do
